verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a speech-to-text service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents hosted surfaces: a cloud Jobs API, a hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.speechischeap.com, an x402 API, and US-East storage with no customer-selectable residency. Nothing shows a self-hostable build, container, on-prem option, or published source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
